name: Banana Protein Pancakes
instructions: Blend oats, bananas, eggs, protein powder and milk until smooth.
Melt a little butter in a nonstick pan over medium heat.
Cook 1/4-cup scoops of batter 2 minutes per side.
Cool completely and stack with parchment between layers. Reheat in a toaster.

name: Berry Overnight Oats
instructions: Stir oats, almond milk, yogurt, chia and honey together in a large bowl.
Divide between 4 jars or containers.
Top each with blueberries, seal, and refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight.
Eat cold, or microwave 60 seconds.

name: Chocolate Chia Pudding
instructions: Whisk almond milk, cocoa and maple syrup until smooth, then whisk in the chia seeds.
Divide between 4 jars and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight; stir once after 30 minutes.
Top with sliced banana, strawberries and a spoonful of almond butter when serving.

name: Freezer Breakfast Burritos
instructions: Dice onion and pepper and cook in a skillet 5 minutes.
Add beaten eggs and scramble until just set.
Stir in black beans and salsa; remove from heat.
Fill tortillas with the mixture and cheese; roll up tightly.
Wrap each in foil. Refrigerate 4 days or freeze up to 2 months. Reheat 90 seconds in the microwave.

name: Greek Yogurt Parfait Jars
instructions: Slice the strawberries and roughly chop the almonds.
Layer yogurt and strawberries in 4 jars; drizzle with honey.
Keep granola and almonds in a separate bag and add just before eating to keep them crunchy.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Oat Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 180°C / 350°F and grease a baking dish.
Mash the bananas and stir in almond milk, peanut butter, maple syrup and chia seeds.
Mix in the oats, pour into the dish and bake 30 minutes until set.
Cut into 6 portions. Keeps 5 days; reheat 60 seconds in the microwave.

name: Sweet Potato & Black Bean Breakfast Hash
instructions: Dice sweet potato small and sauté in olive oil 12 minutes until tender.
Add onion, pepper, cumin and chili powder; cook 5 minutes.
Stir in black beans until hot.
Divide into containers; add salsa and sliced avocado just before eating.

name: Sweet Potato Spinach Egg Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 190°C / 375°F. Thinly slice the sweet potato and roast 15 minutes.
Sauté onion, pepper and mushrooms in olive oil; add spinach until wilted.
Layer sweet potato and vegetables in a baking dish. Pour over the whisked eggs and salt.
Bake 25 minutes until set. Cut into 6 portions.

name: Sweet Potato Turkey Hash
instructions: Dice sweet potato small and sauté in olive oil 12 minutes until tender.
Add onion, pepper, turkey and paprika; cook until the turkey is browned.
Fold in spinach until wilted.
Fry or poach the eggs separately and add one to each container when serving.

name: Tofu Veggie Scramble
instructions: Dice the sweet potato small and roast at 200°C / 400°F for 25 minutes.
Sauté onion, pepper and mushrooms in olive oil 6 minutes.
Crumble in the tofu with cumin, paprika and salt; cook 8 minutes until golden.
Fold in spinach until wilted. Divide with the roasted sweet potato.

name: Veggie Egg Muffins
instructions: Heat oven to 190°C / 375°F and grease a 12-cup muffin tin.
Sauté onion and pepper in olive oil 4 minutes, add spinach until wilted.
Whisk eggs and milk, stir in vegetables and feta.
Pour into the tin and bake 20 minutes until set.
Cool, then store. Per container: 2 muffins.

name: Black Bean Quinoa Salad
instructions: Cook quinoa (amount is dry weight) and cool. Thaw the corn.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice and cumin for the dressing.
Dice pepper, tomato and onion; toss everything except the avocado with the dressing.
Divide into containers and add diced avocado just before eating.

name: Chicken Burrito Bowls
instructions: Cook rice according to the package (amount listed is dry weight).
Season chicken with cumin and chili powder; cook in olive oil 6 minutes per side. Rest, then slice.
Sauté diced pepper 4 minutes.
Build each container: rice, beans, chicken, pepper. Add salsa and avocado just before eating.

name: Chicken Teriyaki Stir-Fry Bowls
instructions: Cook rice (amount is dry weight).
Slice chicken and sear in olive oil until cooked through.
Add garlic and vegetables; cook 5 minutes.
Stir in soy sauce and honey until glossy. Serve over rice.

name: Chickpea Curry Rice Bowls
instructions: Cook rice (amount is dry weight).
Sauté onion, ginger and garlic in olive oil 5 minutes; stir in curry powder 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, coconut milk and chickpeas; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in spinach until wilted and serve over rice.

name: Greek Chicken Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta (amount is dry weight), rinse under cold water.
Cook chicken in a pan, then dice.
Mix yogurt, olive oil and lemon juice into a dressing.
Toss everything together with diced cucumber and tomato; top with feta.

name: Greek Lentil Salad Jars
instructions: Cook lentils (amount is dry weight) until just tender; drain and cool.
Whisk olive oil and lemon juice for the dressing.
Layer dressing, lentils, diced cucumber, tomato and onion, spinach and crumbled feta in jars.

name: Lentil Soup with Toast
instructions: Sauté onion, carrot and garlic in olive oil 6 minutes.
Add lentils, tomatoes, broth and cumin; simmer 30 minutes.
Stir in spinach for the last 2 minutes.
Portion into containers; sprinkle with parmesan. Pack a slice of toast with each.

name: Mediterranean Quinoa Jars
instructions: Cook quinoa (amount is dry weight) and cool.
Whisk olive oil and lemon juice for the dressing.
Dice cucumber, tomato and onion.
Layer dressing, chickpeas, vegetables, quinoa and feta in jars. Shake or stir to serve.

name: Peanut Noodle Bowls with Tofu
instructions: Cube the tofu and bake at 200°C / 400°F for 25 minutes until firm.
Cook the rice noodles per the package and rinse in cold water.
Whisk peanut butter, tamari, lemon juice, maple syrup, garlic and ginger with a few spoons of warm water.
Toss noodles with sauce; top with tofu, shredded carrot and sliced cucumber.

name: Sweet Potato Black Bean Tacos
instructions: Dice sweet potato, toss with olive oil, cumin and chili powder, and roast at 200°C / 400°F for 25 minutes.
Warm the black beans with a splash of water.
Keep tortillas, filling, salsa and avocado (tossed in lemon juice) separate; assemble 2 tacos per serving.

name: Tofu Fried Rice Bowls
instructions: Cook rice (amount is dry weight) and cool; day-old rice works best.
Crumble tofu and fry in olive oil 8 minutes until golden.
Add vegetables, ginger and garlic; cook 5 minutes.
Stir in rice and tamari and fry 3 more minutes.

name: Tuna Chickpea Wraps
instructions: Drain tuna; mash with chickpeas, yogurt, lemon juice and finely diced onion.
Fill tortillas with spinach, cucumber slices and the tuna mix.
Roll tightly and wrap in foil. Keeps 3 days.

name: Beef & Broccoli Rice Bowls
instructions: Cook rice (amount is dry weight).
Brown the beef with garlic in olive oil; drain excess fat.
Add broccoli florets and a splash of water; cover 4 minutes.
Stir in soy sauce and honey. Serve over rice.

name: Chicken Fajita Sheet Pan
instructions: Heat oven to 220°C / 425°F.
Slice chicken, peppers and onion; toss with oil, chili powder and cumin.
Roast on a sheet pan 20 minutes.
Serve with warmed tortillas and a spoon of yogurt.

name: Chickpea Eggplant Stew over Quinoa
instructions: Cube the eggplant and brown in olive oil 8 minutes.
Add onion, garlic and spices for 3 minutes, then tomatoes and chickpeas.
Simmer 20 minutes; stir in spinach.
Cook quinoa (dry weight) and portion the stew over it.

name: Coconut Lentil Curry with Rice
instructions: Sauté onion, carrot, ginger and garlic in olive oil 6 minutes; stir in curry powder.
Add lentils (dry weight), tomatoes, coconut milk and broth; simmer 25 minutes until the lentils are soft.
Stir in spinach. Cook rice separately (dry weight) and portion the curry over it.

name: Gluten-Free Chicken Veggie Stir-Fry
instructions: Cook rice (amount is dry weight).
Slice chicken thinly and sauté in olive oil 6 minutes.
Add vegetables, ginger and garlic; cook 5 minutes.
Stir in tamari and maple syrup for 1 minute. Serve over rice.

name: Loaded Sweet Potatoes with Tempeh & Black Beans
instructions: Bake whole sweet potatoes at 200°C / 400°F for 45 minutes until soft.
Crumble tempeh and brown with onion, cumin and chili powder 8 minutes; add black beans and spinach until hot.
Split the potatoes and fill. Add salsa and avocado (tossed in lemon juice) when serving.

name: Sheet-Pan Salmon, Broccoli & Sweet Potato
instructions: Heat oven to 220°C / 425°F.
Cube sweet potato, toss with half the oil, and roast 15 minutes.
Add broccoli and garlic tossed in oil; nestle the salmon on the tray.
Roast 12 more minutes; squeeze lemon over everything.

name: Shrimp Fried Rice
instructions: Cook rice (amount is dry weight) and cool.
Scramble eggs in a hot wok with oil and set aside.
Stir-fry shrimp and garlic 3 minutes, add vegetables and cauliflower rice.
Add cooked rice, eggs and soy sauce; toss until hot.

name: Shrimp Veggie Rice Noodle Stir-Fry
instructions: Cook the rice noodles per the package and rinse.
Sauté ginger and garlic in olive oil 30 seconds, add shrimp and cook 3 minutes.
Add vegetables 4 minutes, then noodles and tamari; toss until hot.

name: Teriyaki Tofu Broccoli Bowls
instructions: Cook rice (amount is dry weight).
Cube tofu and pan-fry in olive oil 10 minutes until golden.
Add broccoli and sliced carrot with a splash of water; cover 4 minutes.
Whisk tamari, maple syrup, ginger and garlic; toss through for 2 minutes. Serve over rice.

name: Three-Bean Veggie Chili
instructions: Sauté onion, pepper and carrot in olive oil 8 minutes.
Add spices and cook 1 minute, then add tomatoes and beans with 300 ml water.
Simmer 30 minutes, adding salt to taste.
Cook rice (amount is dry weight) and portion the chili over it.

name: Turkey Chili over Rice
instructions: Brown turkey in olive oil with onion and pepper.
Add spices, tomatoes, beans and broth; simmer 30 minutes.
Cook rice (amount is dry weight).
Portion chili over rice in each container.

name: Turkey Meatballs with Marinara & Pasta
instructions: Heat oven to 200°C / 400°F. Mix turkey, egg, parmesan and minced garlic; roll into 20 meatballs.
Bake 18 minutes.
Cook pasta (amount is dry weight); sauté diced zucchini in olive oil.
Warm marinara, add meatballs, and serve over pasta and zucchini.

name: Veggie Marinara Pasta Bake
instructions: Heat oven to 190°C / 375°F. Cook pasta (dry weight) 2 minutes short of the package time.
Mix pasta with marinara, diced zucchini, mushrooms, spinach and cottage cheese.
Spread in a dish, top with parmesan and bake 30 minutes.

name: Apple & Almond Butter Packs
instructions: Slice apples and toss with a little lemon water to prevent browning.
Pack with a small container of almond butter (25 g each).

name: Baked Sweet Potato Rounds with Hummus
instructions: Slice sweet potato into 1 cm rounds, toss with olive oil, paprika and salt.
Roast at 220°C / 425°F for 25 minutes, turning once.
Pack with hummus on the side.

name: Cocoa Almond Energy Bites
instructions: Mix everything in a bowl until it holds together.
Chill 15 minutes, then roll into 16 balls.
Refrigerate up to 1 week. Per container: 2 bites.

name: Cottage Cheese Berry Bowls
instructions: Divide cottage cheese between 4 containers.
Top with sliced strawberries, chopped walnuts and a drizzle of honey.

name: Crispy Roasted Chickpeas
instructions: Heat oven to 200°C / 400°F. Dry the chickpeas very well.
Toss with oil and spices; spread on a tray.
Roast 25–30 minutes, shaking halfway, until crunchy. Store loosely covered.

name: Egg & Veggie Snack Packs
instructions: Boil eggs 10 minutes, cool in ice water, and peel.
Cut carrot and pepper into sticks and halve the tomatoes.
Pack 2 eggs with vegetables per container; a pinch of salt on the side.

name: Guacamole & Veggie Sticks
instructions: Mash avocado with lemon juice and salt; fold in finely diced tomato and onion.
Cut carrot, cucumber and pepper into sticks.
Pack guacamole in small containers beside the vegetables.

name: Hummus & Veggie Snack Boxes
instructions: Cut carrots, cucumber and pepper into sticks.
Fill each box with hummus, vegetables and a small handful of almonds.

name: Peanut Butter Oat Bites
instructions: Mix everything in a bowl until it holds together.
Chill 15 minutes, then roll into 16 balls.
Refrigerate up to 1 week. Per container: 2 bites.

name: Trail Mix Packs
instructions: Combine everything in a large bowl.
Divide into 8 small bags or containers (about 50 g each).
